project.name: @kehto/wm
project.summary: A draft window-manager contract for shells that host napplets (sandboxed iframe apps): shared shapes for windows and their screen positions, a slot for a layout strategy the shell writes itself, and a small service that keeps a window list and focus. The service never runs the strategy; shells call it themselves. Not part of the napplet protocol.

nodes.label: Window manager contract
nodes.summary: Defines what a window and its placement look like and the layout-strategy interface a shell plugs in; its service tracks windows, focus and the active workspace and reports changes to the shell, but leaves layout to the shell.

files.name: Window manager contract
files.d: Defines windows, placements and the layout-strategy slot; its service tracks windows and focus but never calls the strategy or sets a size itself.
files.doc: Generic window-manager contracts for NIP-5D shells.
s: Stable identifier for a managed window.
Workspace identifier; shells may use numeric or string labels.
Minimal universal window descriptor passed to layout strategies.
id + rect only — the output of a layout strategy pass.
Pure function contract for consumer layout strategies.
Notification-only hooks invoked by WmService on window/workspace lifecycle.
Create a WM service. If `strategy` is omitted, a no-op identity strategy is used (returns windows unchanged) — consumers can ship a working shell before implementing a concrete layout.

tour.title: What this package is
tour.note: One file of shared shapes plus a small window service. New windows start with no size, and the stored strategy is never called by the service itself: the shell runs its own layout.
